svg.text: Actual NK children and registered-bank geometry: source-bound compression reference
Historical 73-bank reference; actual 198-bit TX source simplification is being proved and will supersede this inventory.
Compressed: 37,392 actual LEF payload pairs ≥15.449 ps margin; all 87 reset targets ≥48.914 ps. Geometry screens only.
Residual/control source, native outer pins, clock delivery, full programme, route TT/FF/DRC and complete die hardware remain open.
